rafael: Starting maintenance window in 15m for tenant_preferences column add + incremental backfill. This one uses safepoint + quiesce to avoid long locks. Canaries first.
deploybot: [automated] kickoff 3210004321: canary_shards=2 allocated. controller=inc-backfill-v3. Dashboard: https://ci.internal/backfills/3210004321 :robot_face:
emily: Runbook copy: shadow copy already built. Backfill plan: incremental workers, batch_size=400, concurrency=3, sleep_between_batches=100ms. Feature-flag dark-launch off until swap.
cassie: Rolling notes: pin app-connector to 3.7.2 for this window, we saw schema warnings with 3.8.0. Also adding rollback criteria: sustained error_rate>1.5% for 4m OR p99>350ms for 3m -> rollback.
rafael: Also safepoint plan: acquire quiesce lock (shared short) then freeze writes for <2s during metadata swap. If quiesce cannot be acquired within 90s abort and rollback.
deploybot: [automated] snapshot @3210004500: replica_lag=0.9s, processed_rows=950000, errors=0, p95=64ms, p99=110ms
emily: canary healthy, scaling to 5 shards.
deploybot: [automated] canary progress: 3/5 shards done, avg_rate=380r/s, db_p99=160ms
cassie: p99 climbing; set RATE_LIMIT=300 and CONCURRENCY=2. Also enabling KV soft-eviction to free space if mem>75%.
emily: applied flags: RATE_LIMIT=300 CONCURRENCY=2 KV_EVICT=soft 75%
deploybot: [automated] mid snapshot @3210004800: replica_lag=3.5s, processed_rows=2,700,000, errors=3, p95=86ms, p99=205ms
cassie: Replica lag jumped, likely due to replica maintenance. Rafael, should we pause assignment?
rafael: Pause new shard pickup. Let current workers finish. If lag>12s for >2m -> rollback.
deploybot: [automated] worker state: paused new assignment, inflight_workers=4, queue=2
emily: manual check: pg_stat_activity: one replica catchup causing 50ms spikes, no long locks.
cassie: setting alert: if errors>20 during drain -> immediate abort.
deploybot: [automated] snapshot @3210005100: replica_lag=2.1s, processed_rows=3,450,000, errors=6, p95=76ms, p99=148ms. inflight_workers draining. Waiting for resume command.
emily: plan: monitor 10m; if stable we proceed to safepoint and swap. If thresholds crossed, follow rollback: 1) cancel workers 2) restore feature-flag state 3) run fast revert (shadow-table left in place) 4) unpin connector to 3.7.1 and redeploy clients. Keep thread updated.afael: Thanks — will update the release ticket and alert SRE if we need rollback. Leaving thread open for live telemetry.
